claim.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city of

roles.L0/N1518+: Reads the current token ' of' at the last position straight from the embedding (1.57 here, about -0.15 when the last token is a noun such as ' centre') and writes an 'after a preposition' feature that the later neurons build on.
roles.L1/N386+: Layer-1 neuron at the last position that fires on ' of' (1.06) and adds to the determiner-next feature.
roles.L1/N1902+: Layer-1 neuron at the last position that fires on ' of' (1.04, about -0.15 on ' centre') and pushes toward a determiner as the next token.
roles.L2/N417+: Middle-layer relay at the last position (0.69) that carries the preposition feature on to the late MLPs.
roles.L4/N890+: Late neuron at the last position (0.70) that turns the preposition context into support for the answer ' the'.
roles.L4/N1617+: Late neuron at the last position (1.18) that adds support for ' the' after ' of'.
roles.L5/N552+: Final-layer writer (1.15 here, 0.17 on ' centre') whose output raises the logit of ' the' (single-pole mean-ablation cut 0.30 nats).
roles.L5/N766+: Final-layer writer (1.33 here, -0.17 on ' centre') and the largest single writer of ' the' in the route (cut 0.25 nats).

claim.explanation: The answer is the generic 'preposition, then determiner' continuation. It is not a fact about Paris. ' the' wins with only about 3% probability, because no entity completion is stronger here. A chain of last-position MLP neurons reads the current token ' of'. They start at L0/N1518+ and L1/N386+/N1902+, which react to the token embedding. L2/N417+ relays them, and L4/N890+, L4/N1617+, L5/N552+ and L5/N766+ write ' the' into the logits. Each neuron moves only 5-12% alone, but together they carry the answer. Patching the eight neurons from 'The Eiffel Tower is in the city centre' gives 0.56 of the clean-to-corrupted gap. With the noun 'limits', 'streets', 'hall' or 'today' in place of ' of' it gives 0.59-0.71. Matched random sets give at most 0.03. No attention head matters much: the best single head patch is 0.06. Caveat: on this prompt, mean-ablating every unit raises log p(' the') from -3.44 to -3.29. So the all-unit cut is negative, and the necessity share is undefined (the gate reads 0). The route's own cut is +1.67 nats.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the heart of
counterfactuals.why: The source ' of' stays as the last token, so the preposition neurons still fire and write ' the'. 'heart of' adds no rival entity completion.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the middle of
counterfactuals.why: Same source ' of' after a different noun. The route reads only the last-token preposition, so ' the' stays top.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city from
counterfactuals.why: A source swap that should keep the answer. ' from' is another preposition that wants a determiner next, so the same preposition-to-determiner neurons carry ' the'.

counterfactuals.prompt: I live in the city of
counterfactuals.why: The source ' of' is the same, and nothing in the prompt names a city. So the generic ' the' from the route stays top.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city centre
counterfactuals.why: A source swap that should change the answer. A noun replaces ' of', so L0/N1518+, L1/N1902+, L5/N552+ and L5/N766+ go silent and punctuation (',') wins.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city that
counterfactuals.why: ' that' is not a preposition before a noun phrase, so the route does not fire and a verb (' is') wins.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city.
counterfactuals.why: A full stop ends the clause, so no preposition is there for the route to read, and a newline wins.

counterfactuals.prompt: The Louvre Museum is in the city of
counterfactuals.why: The route writes only a weak generic ' the' (about 3%). With a subject the model ties more strongly to a city, the entity completion ' Paris' outbids it.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the center of
prompts.why: Same ' of' last token after a different noun; route reads ' of' so ' the' should stay top.

prompts.prompt: The Statue of Liberty stands at the edge of
prompts.why: Different topic, ' of' last token; generic preposition then determiner.

prompts.prompt: She was the leader of
prompts.why: Unrelated sentence ending in ' of'; route is claimed generic.

prompts.prompt: Bananas are one of
prompts.why: ' of' in a different sense (partitive); ' the' is a strong continuation.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city of the
prompts.why: Last token is ' the', not ' of'; the route reads ' of', so the answer should move to a noun.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city of Paris, which is the capital of
prompts.why: Distractor entity earlier; final ' of' after longer context; route should still carry ' the' (likely France though, so a risk).

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city located in the heart of
prompts.why: Extra words between source and earlier tokens; last token ' of' same.

prompts.prompt: Paris is the capital city of
prompts.why: Fact-driven answer (France) beats the generic ' the'; route should not carry it.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city of Paris in
prompts.why: Last token ' in' after an entity; answer shifts to a country/determiner mix; route is tied to ' of'.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city center
prompts.why: Noun last token; route neurons are about -0.15 on nouns, answer should change.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city and
prompts.why: Conjunction last token, no preposition feature.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city, in the middle of
prompts.why: Comma clause then ' of'; same last token.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city off
prompts.why: Another preposition last token; claim covers 'from' so should carry.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city with
prompts.why: Preposition with a determiner-next feature; same route family.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city is
prompts.why: Verb last token; no preposition context.

prompts.prompt: Eiffel Tower city the in is The of
prompts.why: Scrambled word order but still ends in ' of'; a last-token route should not care about context.

prompts.prompt: I love the taste of
prompts.why: Unrelated context, ' of' last; tests that route is token-local.

The Eiffel Tower is in the city of

The Eiffel Tower is in the city of
prompts.why: Repeated prompt; induction could favour a copied answer, which tests whether ' the' stays via the route.

prompts.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is in the city named
prompts.why: Participle last token leading to a proper noun, not a determiner.
